feed.title: Feed advice
health.3h: Call a vet if it is serious
health.advice.huddling: Often too cold. Check the brooder heat first.
health.advice.lame: Check the litter is dry and the birds are not too crowded. If many birds, talk to a vet.
health.advice.loose_droppings: Many causes, like a feed change or infection. Talk to a vet.
health.advice.noisy_breathing: Can be a breathing infection. Keep the shed airy and talk to a vet.
health.advice.not_eating: Check that feeders and water are easy to reach. Then talk to a vet.
health.advice.panting: Heat stress. Give more air and plenty of cool water.
health.advice.sudden_deaths: Call a vet today. Remove dead birds and keep one for the vet to check.
health.title: Flock health
health.vet: This is general advice, not a diagnosis. If many birds are sick or dying, call a vet today.
